items.title: OpenAI Introduces GPT-6 Sol and Luna, Enhancing Frontier AI Capabilities
items.summary: OpenAI has officially launched GPT-6 Sol and Luna, marking a significant advancement in their frontier AI models with new capabilities.

items.title: Snorkel AI's Valuation Triples to $3.5B Amid Surging Demand for AI Training Data
items.summary: Snorkel AI has seen its valuation triple to $3.5 billion, reflecting the booming market demand for high-quality AI training data.

items.title: Qualcomm Unveils New AI-Focused Smartphone Chips
items.summary: Qualcomm has released two new smartphone chips, placing a strong emphasis on enhanced AI processing capabilities for mobile devices.

items.title: OmniEdu: Open Foundation Models Revolutionize Learning and Teaching
items.summary: OmniEdu introduces open foundation models designed to transform educational practices for both learning and teaching.

items.title: WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory
items.summary: WorldCrafter proposes a novel video world model that achieves consistent generation through implicit 3D-aware memory.

items.title: GameHorizon Suite: Multi-Horizon Data and Evaluation for Advanced Gameplay AI
items.summary: GameHorizon Suite provides comprehensive multi-horizon data and evaluation tools to advance AI research in gameplay.

items.title: DeepSeek Elastic Compute (DSec): Sandbox Infrastructure for Scalable Agentic Training
items.summary: DeepSeek Elastic Compute (DSec) offers a sandbox infrastructure designed for effective and scalable agentic AI training.

items.title: Better Prompt Caching for GPT-6 Improves Efficiency
items.summary: OpenAI announces improvements to prompt caching for GPT-6, aiming to enhance the efficiency and speed of the model.

items.title: Parallel Cuts Research Time and Cost in Half with GPT-6 Astra
items.summary: GPT-6 Astra is enabling Parallel Cuts to halve their research time and costs, demonstrating significant efficiency gains in scientific workflows.

items.title: Realtime-Venus: A Full-Duplex Interaction System with Asynchronous Delegation
items.summary: Realtime-Venus introduces a novel full-duplex interaction system that utilizes asynchronous delegation for more natural and efficient AI communication.

items.title: Document Retrieval-Aware Chunking (D-RAC): Universal Ingestion of Enterprise Documents
items.summary: D-RAC offers a universal method for ingesting enterprise documents into retrieval systems through PDF normalization and multimodal markdown conversion.

items.title: Grounded Action Model: 3D Grounding as a Foundation for Robotics
items.summary: This research proposes a Grounded Action Model that uses 3D grounding as a foundational element for advanced robotics applications.

items.title: VideoGen-Agent: Reinforcing Video Generation Agents for Improved Performance
items.summary: VideoGen-Agent explores methods to reinforce video generation agents, leading to enhanced performance and more realistic video outputs.

items.title: RULER: Instance-aware Rubric Rewards for SVG Generation
items.summary: RULER introduces instance-aware rubric rewards to improve the quality and control of SVG generation processes.

items.title: onPanda: Efficient Annotation of On-Policy Alignment Data for LLMs and Agents
items.summary: onPanda presents an efficient method for annotating on-policy alignment data for Large Language Models and agents using token-level correction.
